summary: Master advanced working capital optimization and cash flow management. Learn to reduce the cash conversion cycle and boost liquidity. Enroll today.
lede: Working capital finance helps senior finance and operations professionals identify cash tied up in receivables, inventory and payables. The course covers cash conversion cycle analysis, credit risk and collections, inventory planning, supplier payment strategies and 13-week cash-flow forecasting. Participants also practice liquidity stress testing and building cash-flow dashboards to support decisions across finance, procurement, sales and operations.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for senior-level finance and operational professionals who are responsible for the strategic management of corporate liquidity and the optimization of the balance sheet.
modules: Strategic Liquidity and Cash Flow Architecture
Advanced Receivables Management and Credit Risk
Inventory Optimization and Supply Chain Integration
Strategic Payables and Supply Chain Finance
Cash Flow Forecasting and Liquidity Stress Testing
Treasury Technology and Digital Cash Management
Integration: The Working Capital Transformation Roadmap
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in finance, treasury, or accounting roles. A working knowledge of financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow Statement) and proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling are required. No prior coding knowledge is necessary.
